name: Summer Days at the J
description_short: Day camp at JCC Mid-Westchester in Scarsdale for toddlers through grade 6. Explorers (twos to kindergarten) play, swim in the indoor pool, garden and bake; Adventurers (grades 1 to 6) pick a morning focus in aquatics, dance and performing arts, trips, gymnastics or STEAM and join general camp activities in the afternoon.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds unless the JCC cancels the program, except for a documented medical reason or a move of more than 30 miles, prorated on written request with a $35 to $50 processing fee.
notes: 2027 early bird tuition, through January 31, 2027 (regular prices not posted). Adventurers: $4,389 for Session 1, $3,292 for Session 2, $7,261 full summer; Expeditions Adventure $4,557, $3,424 and $7,541. Explorers range from $840 (Twos three days a week, Session 2) to $7,092 (Threes, Fours or Ks 9 to 4, full summer). Adventurers 9 am to 4 pm; younger groups have half and partial day options. Early care 8 to 9 am and after care 4 to 6 pm at $30 an hour. Families send snacks and a kosher style, nut free lunch; pizza on Fridays. Five percent sibling discount.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer Days page, 2027: full summer June 28 to August 13, Session 1 June 28 to July 23, Session 2 July 26 to August 13; early bird tuition table for 2027; Explorers from Twos (two by December 31, 2027) to Ks, Adventurers entering grades 1 to 6 in September 2027. age_max derived from grade 6. Camp is framed around Jewish values. No member or non-member split in the tuition table.
